items.reason: Gap 0 describes concurrent duplicate deliveries both seeing the ID absent before either records it and both running the handler.
Gap 2 states that deduplication takes its key from the unsigned X-Event-Id convenience header rather than the signed body ID.
Gap 3 identifies that charge.refunded has no handler because the refund handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap relies on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
